about: Green-screen miner clips for miner.js: 720x1280 H.264, muted, faststart. key = green-dominance (alpha = 1 - (g - max(r,b) - threshold/255) * softness; despill g <= max(r,b) + despill/255). foot = boots point, miner = standing miner height (helmet to boots), lamp = headlamp, bit = jackhammer tip — fractions of the frame, measured from the clips; a point may be keyframes [[t, x, y], ...] over the clip's time. start = where the clip starts playing (s). drillStart hands over to drillLoop (next); drillLoop blends its end into its start (crossfade, s); cash and bust hold their last frame.
